title: Ordered replay, consumed events and independent runs
goal: One arrival promise is created by the later matching event, the consumed no-request event never rebinds, exact event retries add no effect, and ordered replay yields the same business state.
representative_failure: Same-window withdrawal/resubmission remains ambiguous; retries cannot convert old unmatched or ambiguous hotel events into a new confirmation.
